items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Dominick was the first policeman that... He beat me up and I cried

ctx.x: Amsterdam...10th and 11th Avenue. If you had to cross the street, boy, you had to fight your way or something to go to...even go to the store. But on the other side of the street you were safe, because you were on your own, you know... And the Italian was the only guy that had the fruit stand, like the Korean is today -- on the corner. The first one I remember... Dominick was the first policeman that... He beat me up and I cried, because I couldn't speak English real good. Setting fires on the street, you know...…
